```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(readr)

d_coronavirus <- read.csv("../data/life-under-lockdown-wave2-extract.csv")
```

#Hypothesis
H1 Gender is associated with number of conspiracy beliefs

#Findings
```{r}
d_coronavirus %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mdn = median(beliefs),
    M = mean(beliefs),
    SD = sd(beliefs)
  )
```


```{r}
d_coronavirus %>%
  filter(gender != "In another way") %>%
  t.test(
    beliefs ~ gender,
    data = .
  )
```

#Discovery
In the sample, males held more conspiracy beliefs regarding coronavirus than females, but this was not statistically significant, t(494.31) = -1.201, p = .230.
